name: tpt-lean-wasm
description: Restricted, browser-safe WebAssembly bindings for tpt-lean: Lean tokenizer, formatter, CST viewer and index search

scripts.build: cd ../../.. && cargo build -p tpt-lean-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir crates/tpt-lean-wasm/npm/pkg --out-name tpt_lean_wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tpt_lean_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:web: cd ../../.. && cargo build -p tpt-lean-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir crates/tpt-lean-wasm/npm/pkg-web --out-name tpt_lean_wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tpt_lean_wasm.wasm
